limitations: Persona related reads are slower than on 2026-11-07 (BFF 1e4bc7ce5): sequential p50 for /bff/personas?page_size=200 4742 to 6162 ms and persona-management detail 5007 to 6510 ms and /bff/personas/{id} 3988 to 4388 ms; with three parallel callers the max rose 13159 to 18047 ms and 11844 to 15865 ms and 8408 to 11705 ms. Pages: risk center 7.6 to 10.3 s and persona list 6.0 to 8.8 s and deployments 3.2 to 9.6 s and persona header 7.5 to 9.5 s after the drain. The cause is not separated: 41 BFF commits landed between the two versions including persona read changes, and the arena task's own reproduction showed MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 raising wall time 28.4 to 38.6 s for 40 threads. An A/B on the same version is needed.
The 2026-11-08 billing outage restarted the VM at 12:08Z; measurements here start after the stack recovered.
The VACUUM was run once by the operator; nothing in code compacts the file and freed pages are reused.
